paper_title: AI Scientists Fail Without Strong Implementation Capability
caption: Analysis of AI Scientist publications on arXiv. The upper panel displays the average number of citations up to now, categorized by containing implementation details. The lower panel shows the growth in the total number of these papers with the same categorization.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the change in quantity over a specified time period, represented without and with implementation. The x-axis is labeled with time, using specific seasonal labels: Fall '24, Winter '24, and Spring '25. The y-axis is labeled as Quantity and follows a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 24, with tick marks at intervals of 3 units. The plot features two lines. The first line, representing data without implementation, is shown in cyan with circular markers and a solid line style. It starts at a value of 10 in Fall '24, increases to 15 by Winter '24, and rises to 21 in Spring '25. The second line, representing data with implementation, is shown in orange with square markers and a solid line style. It starts at a value of 2 in Fall '24, increases to 7 by Winter '24, and reaches a value of 13 in Spring '25. A legend positioned near the top-left of the plot defines each line by its corresponding implementation information, marker shape and color.
